      theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.joint_projective_stability_or_relation_on (k : Type u) [Field k] {R : Type u} [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [IsNoetherianRing R] (s : Finset (CategoryTheory.Skeleton (FGModuleCat R))) (hs : IsSemibrick ↑s) (t : Finset (CategoryTheory.Skeleton (FGModuleCat R))) (hspan : ∀ (w : Weight (FGModuleCat R)), (∀ x ∈ t, w.eval ((CategoryTheory.fromSkeleton (FGModuleCat R)).obj x) = 0) → ∀ x ∈ s, w.eval ((CategoryTheory.fromSkeleton (FGModuleCat R)).obj x) = 0) :
      let U := ⋃ x ∈ ↑s, properSubobjectClasses ((CategoryTheory.fromSkeleton (FGModuleCat R)).obj x); (∃ (g : ProjectiveClass R), ↑s ⊆ stableClasses ((projectiveClassWeight k) g)) ∨ ∃ (a : ↑U → ℤ) (c : ↥t → ℤ), (∀ (j : ↑U), 0 ≤ a j) ∧ (∃ (j : ↑U), 0 < a j) ∧ ∑ j : ↑U, a j • ↑j = ∑ i : ↥t, c i • GrothendieckGroup.of ((CategoryTheory.fromSkeleton (FGModuleCat R)).obj ↑i)

      For a finite semibrick, either all members are stable at one integral projective weight, or proper subobject classes give a nonnegative, nontrivial integral relation modulo the member classes.
